text:
noah: flying into BCN for a conference in June. Anyone got recs for neighborhood safety + late-night food?
anya: El Raval has great bars but can be sketchy late. Eixample is chill and central.
omar: Gracia is quieter and has nicer tapas spots, but a bit further from the convention center.
katie: late-night food: stay away from the super touristy spots on La Rambla. try Carrer de Blai for pintxos.
noah: transit q: how late do trains run from central to airport?
travel-bot: Info: Aerobus runs until midnight, trains to airport vary by day; check local schedule. Metro L9S runs most hours but not overnight.
anya: Uber/taxis are fine late too, but agree on safety. split fares if you can.
omar: FYI: some tapas places close early around 11-12. Plan for a late dinner like a local (after 9pm)
noah: thanks! adding to my notes.
